status: Awaiting authentic final-build captures; no new screenshot UI or social state has been fabricated.

style.typography: Keep the existing Arial/Helvetica compositor: two short bold lines, a single supporting line, consistent left alignment. No cartoon imagery, badges, stickers, or crowded decorative overlays.
style.composition: One large unchanged native capture inside the existing restrained phone frame. No retouching screen controls or user content. The existing frame preserves the entire image with contain fit.
style.welcome: Keep the existing welcome artwork optional and last. It repeats the lead headline inside the screen and exposes sign-in fields; a concrete quest is the stronger opening image.

captures.required: A successful final-build quest recommendation or accepted-quest overview: concrete title and readable instructions/description, consistent time and budget. Prefer a real friends/Bold/Full Send outing showing spontaneous adventure.
captures.avoid: AI error/fallback banner, incoherent description, guaranteed venue availability/booking/price, exact personal location.

captures.required: Current native Create budget slider or energy choice, with a real selected value. Budget slider is visually strongest; all three energy choices should be visible if using intensity.
captures.avoid: Keyboard, half-filled validation state, clipping or old square buttons.

captures.required: Physical iPhone live native camera preview showing authentic controls and framing. An actual subject must be captured by the app, not composited behind its controls.
captures.avoid: Simulator black preview, a camera permission error, fabricated preview image, real private bystanders or unapproved people.

captures.required: Alternate image 3: genuine completed-video preview or gallery-import session with actual playable recorded footage. Use captures-finished-video-proposed.json instead of the live-camera manifest.
captures.avoid: Test patterns, synthetic creator footage/counts, external TikTok branding, upload/renderer errors.

captures.required: Current native nearby-place search with actual results in a neutral public neighborhood and useful venue names. Native results must be genuine; manual place entry alone does not support the nearby-result image.
captures.avoid: Home address, exact personal pin, invented concert schedules, empty/error results, claimed bookings.

captures.required: Populated current own-Series detail from a genuinely filmed quest, ideally completed Part 1 and Create Part 2 action. A private authentic series is sufficient; do not publish solely for imagery.
captures.avoid: Empty library, obsolete New Series form, invented episode/follower totals, unfinished required validation.

captures.required: Current Journal or own-profile Private tab, populated with one or two real retained quests and a real ready-video thumbnail if available. Journal-only layout with clear status and resume action.
captures.avoid: Account/preferences links inside Private, Start an original, abandoned old layout, private contact details.

finalChecks: Check every composed PNG and contact-sheet.jpg visually at full resolution and phone thumbnail size.
Keep the final manifest list in the intended screenshot order.
No demo/PILOT badge, simulator window chrome, credentials, notifications, real email addresses, test patterns or misleading counters.
No promise of live event inventory, ticket bookings, automatic payouts, viral guarantees or advanced editing.
